reports.protocol: 60Hz; 30 settle frames; one jump at source coordinates 5.5/6/6.5/6.75/6.9 (ledge at 7); run-up from cell 3, or pre-position from cell 5 and stand for 30 frames; hold direction until one cell onto destination; six stable landing frames; 420-frame limit. Step candidates 0..5, gap candidates 0..8. Bounds apply only to this explicit input protocol, not an exhaustive reachability search. map_size is the interior; product canvas remains 30x20.
